items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: George Augustine was a working delegate.

ctx.x: When was that? When did it start? When? Oh, that's been, let me see. George Augustine was a working delegate. Who was that George Augustine? Oh, you know, you lived in St. Edna between Burgundy and Ramport. We used to make meetings there. That's got a big hole there. Yeah. Okay, I'm born. Okay. I'll tell you what you all want. We'll ask you a few questions. Well, that's it. You ask me. I just want to know things like when you were born and where. When I was born? Well, let's wait a little. I think it's working…
Go ahead, any time. Just tell us about when you were born.
